critical_issues.description: React 16.11.0 is from 2019 and contains multiple security vulnerabilities. Upgrade to React 18.x for security patches and performance improvements.
cve_references: Multiple XSS vulnerabilities in older React versions

critical_issues.description: React DOM 16.11.0 contains security vulnerabilities. Must be upgraded in sync with React.

medium_issues.description: react-scripts 5.0.1 itself is up to date, but depends on older tools. After React upgrade, rebuild dependencies.
medium_issues.recommendation: Update React first, then run npm audit fix
medium_issues.notes: This will auto-update via React dependency chain

medium_issues.description: Clarifai 2.9.1 is outdated. Newer versions have security patches and improved API support.

low_issues.description: Package is relatively stable but has newer versions available.
low_issues.recommendation: Consider updating to react-particles@3.0.0+ (note: different package name now)
low_issues.notes: Package maintainers shifted to 'react-particles' instead of 'react-particles-js'

phase_1_steps: Run 'npm install' to resolve peer dependencies
Run 'npm audit fix' for transitive vulnerability fixes
phase_2_steps: Update clarifai to latest (check for breaking changes)
phase_3_steps: Test face recognition features with Clarifai API
Check for console warnings and deprecation notices

additional_security_recommendations: Enable GitHub Dependabot to get automated security alerts
Set up SECURITY.md file for vulnerability reporting
Consider adding security scanning to CI/CD pipeline
Review .env handling for API keys (ensure secrets are not committed)
Add npm audit scanning to pre-commit hooks
